d: A viral social media video shows an exhausted thin construction laborer balancing heavy concrete bricks on his head while climbing stairs in a high-rise building up to the 21st floor, despite four operational lifts being available nearby, sparking widespread outrage over lack of basic humanity and worker exploitation. Shared by X user Amit Singh with the caption highlighting pure lack of basic humanity, the clip depicts the worker drenched in sweat as guards and others sit comfortably, raising questions about why laborers are denied lift access.
